text: If there were zero stars, I would give it to zero. I went to get two teeth filled. After the fillings were done, my teeth were sensitive, like the fillings weren't covering the area from the first day. Not long after, both fillings started to fall out. There was no responsibility to fix it, saying I had to pay again. I've never had a filling fall out like this before. This is the worst place.

text: 9/4/68 2:30 PM. The old male doctor was terrible. He refused to examine me first, wouldn't listen to which tooth hurt, and just wanted to extract it as if he was in a hurry. He used a tool to break a tooth that wasn't even there for examination. He wouldn't give me back the tooth that was extracted, claiming it was for medical students.
